title: Sculptural Works
description: Sculpture in steel, timber and line: curved steel planes held in space by taut cord, rusted sheet forms pinned by red lines, and frames suspended across a room in thread, each exploring balance, tension and how a form changes as you move around it.
study_intro: Balance, tension and line: steel and timber made to look weightless.

study.label: Form
study.text: Curved steel planes and long timber members held at improbable angles.

study.label: Line
study.text: Taut cord and thread pin the forms in space and draw across the whole room.

study.label: Material
study.text: Raw and rusted steel, set against clean white walls.
